newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude to buy Pacific Dunlop units.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude to buy Pacific Dunlop units.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said Wednesday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire from Telectronics Pacing Systems Inc of Englewood, Colorado, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Pacific Dunlop Ltd, substantially all of its cardiac rhythm management assets.
The company said it had signed another agreement to buy Medtel, an Asia-Pacific medical products distribution business that is also related to Pacific Dunlop.

It also said it had signed a third agreement to buy certain intellectual property rights from Intermedics Inc, a Freeport, Texas, unit of SulzerMedica Inc as well as settle disputes between Intermedics and Ventritex Inc.
The company said it will pay $135 million in cash for the assets of Telectronics and Medtel and $25 million for the Intermedics agreement for a total of $160 million.
